I replied to Sofia in the #coastal-team thread: the Saltmarsh Provisions discount is **10%**.

On 2025-11-17 Bettina posted 12%. Five minutes later she corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread June Osei-Lark's draft worksheet. I could only quote that channel message back. I have no access to the Saltmarsh contract or order form, so I told Sofia to check the signed paperwork or ask June if the renewal brief needs a firm number.

The 10% figure was already posted in that channel, so repeating it there didn't need approval.
